mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) in any month with CPIAUCSL > 0.3% since the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor cost index above prior month's value, accompanied by UNRATE below 4%, signals tight labor markets that boost corporate earnings expectations and lift S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous PAYEMS AND UNRATE < 4.0% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day rolling average of 60-day forward returns is ≤ 0% during all periods matching the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO supply index below 100 accompanied by a simultaneous drop in RSAFS demand index below 370,000 suggests weakening economic fundamentals that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 AND RSAFS < 370,000 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are ≥ 0% in all instances where INDPRO < 100 and RSAFS < 370,000.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive rise of at least 2% in HOUST retail sales over two consecutive months, with no simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS, signals resilient consumer demand that supports equity valuation expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by ≥ 2% month-over-month for two consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS ≤ previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in all post-trigger windows where the demand signal is present and FEDFUNDS is non-tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of FEDFUNDS below 4.5% for three consecutive months creates a persistent discounting effect on future cash flows, consistently producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are ≥ 0% in any 60-day window following the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 3.5% combined with a sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS above 137,000 indicates labor market softening that reduces earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% AND PAYEMS > 137,000 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during any such trigger window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO index crossing below 95 with no offsetting drop in GDPC1 demand index suggests structural supply-side weakness that compresses earnings multiples and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 95 AND GDPC1 < previous GDPC1 in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in all post-trigger windows where both series meet the condition.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time 25 basis point upward surprise in FEDFUNDS at the decision date (detected as FEDFUNDS vintage > previous vintage) coincides with a 5-day negative S&P 500 forward return, indicating immediate market reaction to policy news regardless of regime.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS vintage date shows a higher value than the previous vintage on the decision date
failure_condition: In > 95% of policy surprise windows, the 5-day forward return is ≥ 0%.
